mode: local, every operation through `gbrain call`, the local dispatch of its MCP tools
door: search(query, limit=8, snippet_chars=0) plus recall(query, limit=8), plus get_page for the entity pages the question names
results: limit 8 on search and recall (adapter's choice; gbrain's defaults not stated), no character cut; when every hit is a weak semantic match only two are kept
not_default: embedding model ollama:nomic-embed-text (768) set at init (without an embedding provider gbrain has keyword search only)
